fomc_meeting_pricing.note: Approximate meeting path from CME 30-day Fed Funds futures (not Fed-dated OIS / FedWatch). Each meeting maps to the contract month after the decision as a post-meeting rate proxy. Probabilities assume 25bp steps (FedWatch-style). Monthly FF contracts average EFFR over the calendar month — use CME FedWatch or OIS for precise per-meeting pricing.
